headline: Attackers actively exploit an N-able N-central authentication bypass to seize managed endpoints as INC ransomware roots SonicWall VPN appliances and Iran's water-system campaign spreads to seven states.

emerging_trends.text: Threat actors are hammering enterprise remote-access gear, chaining an authentication bypass in N-able's N-central to reach thousands of managed endpoints while INC ransomware roots SonicWall VPN appliances.
emerging_trends.topic_title: N-able N-central Auth Bypass Exploited in the Wild

emerging_trends.text: Iran-linked intrusions against U.S. water utilities have jumped past Minnesota into Michigan, South Dakota, and Georgia, marking small municipal systems as soft targets for geopolitical pressure.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Iran Water Attacks Spread to Seven States

emerging_trends.text: Passwordless promises are fraying as Unit 42 shows local malware can drain passkey-protected accounts straight out of Chrome's Google Password Manager with no fingerprint required.
emerging_trends.topic_title: Malware Hijacks Passkeys via Google Password Manager

topics.title: N-able N-central Auth Bypass Exploited in the Wild
topics.latest_developments: N-able confirmed its first fix was incomplete and shipped build 2026.3.1.7 on August 2 as the first safe version after attackers used a patch bypass to take over N-central servers and reach the customer endpoints behind them.
topics.summary: CVE-2026-18577 is an authentication bypass in N-able N-central, the remote monitoring and management platform managed service providers run to control customer fleets; attackers gain remote administrative access to servers and the managed endpoints they reach. N-central operators should update to build 2026.3.1.7 and hunt for intrusions.

sources.title: N-able Says Attackers Take Over N-central Servers After Initial Fix Proves Incomplete
N-able warns of N-central auth bypass flaw exploited in attacks
Attackers exploit N-able N-central flaw to reach managed endpoints (CVE-2026-18577)
N-able Patches Vulnerability Exploited to Hack N-central Servers

topics.title: INC Ransomware Exploits SonicWall SMA 1000 Flaws
topics.latest_developments: Resecurity named INC Ransomware the dominant actor exploiting recently disclosed SonicWall SMA 1000 flaws, accelerating attacks since the start of August 2026 and posting multiple victims to its data leak site.
topics.summary: SonicWall Secure Mobile Access 1000-series VPN appliances carry recently disclosed vulnerabilities that the INC Ransomware gang exploits for root access and lateral movement into corporate networks. Organizations running SMA 1000 appliances should patch immediately and check for compromise.

sources.title: INC Ransomware Emerges as Dominant Actor Exploiting SonicWall SMA 1000 Flaws
Recent SonicWall Vulnerabilities Exploited in Ransomware Attacks

topics.title: PNLD Breach Exposes U.K. Police Data
topics.latest_developments: The ExfilSquad group leaked contact details of more than 100,000 U.K. police officers, staff, and criminal justice professionals stolen from the Police National Legal Database and published the data on the dark web.
topics.summary: The Police National Legal Database, a U.K. legal-reference service, suffered a breach identified July 26 that exposed names, organizations, and work email addresses of police officers, government partners, and customers. Affected personnel face heightened phishing and impersonation risk.

sources.title: ExfilSquad hackers leak info of over 100,000 UK police officers, staff
PNLD Breach Exposes U.K. Police and Government Contact Details on Dark Web

topics.title: Malware Hijacks Passkeys via Google Password Manager
topics.latest_developments: Unit 42 detailed three attack paths—Pass-ta-key, Silver Pass-ta-key, and Golden Pass-ta-key—that let malware running as an ordinary Windows user sign into passkey-protected accounts through Chrome's Google Password Manager cloud authenticator with no fingerprint, PIN, or on-screen prompt, the strongest variant stealing the master key.
topics.summary: Chrome's Google Password Manager doubles as a cloud authenticator for passkeys; Unit 42 showed local malware can abuse it to take over passkey-protected accounts silently. The finding follows Unit 42's separate report that unvalidated User Verified flags downgrade passkey multifactor authentication to a single factor.

sources.title: Google Password Manager Attacks Could Let Malware Hijack Passkey-Protected Accounts

topics.title: Iran Water Attacks Spread to Seven States
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek reported that the Iran-linked campaign against U.S. water systems reaches at least six states beyond Minnesota, including Michigan, South Dakota, and Georgia.
topics.summary: Iran-linked attackers target internet-exposed controls at small U.S. community water utilities, changing passwords and locking out operators. CISA urges the water and wastewater sector to pull exposed programmable logic controllers offline.

sources.title: US Water Cyberattacks Extend Beyond Minnesota to at Least 6 Other States

topics.title: Hugging Face Diffusers Flaws Enable Code Execution
topics.latest_developments: Researchers disclosed three high-severity flaws in Hugging Face's Diffusers library that let crafted model repositories bypass the trust_remote_code safeguard and silently run arbitrary code on machines loading them.
topics.summary: Diffusers is a widely used library for running AI image and diffusion models; the flaws let a malicious model repository execute code despite trust_remote_code, the protection meant to stop unreviewed code from running, opening the AI supply chain to compromise. Users should update.

sources.title: Hugging Face Diffusers Flaws Could Let Model Repositories Execute Arbitrary Code

business_politics.title: Japan and U.S. Vow Further Yen Intervention
business_politics.latest_developments: Japanese finance minister Satsuki Katayama confirmed Tokyo will again intervene jointly with Washington to steady the yen, extending the coordinated action the U.S. Treasury began July 31.
business_politics.summary: Satsuki Katayama, Japan's finance minister, said Tokyo and the U.S. Treasury stand ready to intervene together in currency markets to counter disorderly moves in the yen, building on the New York Fed's July 31 dollar sales, Washington's first intervention to support the currency.

sources.title: Japan vows further yen intervention with US if needed

business.title: Wayfair Plans First Pennsylvania Store
business.latest_developments: Wayfair confirmed it will open its first Pennsylvania brick-and-mortar store in the Pittsburgh region, growing a physical footprint that now numbers three stores nationwide.
business.summary: Online furniture retailer Wayfair, which runs just three physical stores, chose the Pittsburgh area for its first Pennsylvania storefront as it adds locations across the country.

business.title: Strip District Adds Retail as Building Slows
business.latest_developments: A state-of-the-neighborhood review found the Strip District added 16 businesses over the past year, its strongest run of new openings since 2022, even as large-scale development cools.
business.summary: Pittsburgh's Strip District gained 16 new businesses in the past year, its best showing since 2022, as the neighborhood shifts from a construction boom toward a retail boost, WPXI reported.

around_town.title: Cyclosporiasis Outbreak Turns Deadly
around_town.latest_developments: Health officials reported the first two deaths tied to the region's cyclosporiasis outbreak, an escalation from the 35 infections and two hospitalizations Allegheny County counted a week ago.
around_town.summary: Two people have died in the cyclosporiasis outbreak that has sickened dozens across the region, health officials said Monday, the first fatalities in the parasitic-infection cluster the Pennsylvania Department of Health has tracked.

sources.title: First deaths reported in cyclosporiasis outbreak

around_town.title: City Gives 750 Employees Free Transit
around_town.latest_developments: Pittsburgh began offering free public transit to 750 city employees, a program officials hope will lift downtown foot traffic as workers return in person.
around_town.summary: Pittsburgh will provide free public transportation to 750 city employees, an initiative city officials say should also boost downtown activity as more staff return to in-person work.

around_town.title: Fetterman, McCormick Back Lanternfly Bill
around_town.latest_developments: Pennsylvania senators John Fetterman and Dave McCormick joined two colleagues to introduce the Spotted Lanternfly Research and Development Act, aimed at the invasive insect spreading across the state.
around_town.summary: U.S. senators John Fetterman and Dave McCormick of Pennsylvania co-sponsored the bipartisan Spotted Lanternfly Research and Development Act, which would make the crop-threatening invasive insect a high-priority research initiative for the National Institute of Food and Agriculture.

sources.title: Pennsylvania senators introduce bill to stop spread of spotted lanternflies
